QUOTE: "`ResponseGenerator` observer | `dispatch_batch_generate` | Mirrors the engine interrupt flag into the C-ABI int" and "which the code comments say was avoided to keep the boundary `int*`-only"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the observer mirrors the atomic interrupt flag into a plain C-ABI int, and that the C ABI was kept `int*`-only so it carries no atomic.
